1: # Dungeon Haul — Aesthetic Brief
2: 
3: > **Status:** Documentation only (no binary art).  
4: > **Sources:** TOJam 8 design document (§1–§5 mockups), [ARCHITECTURE.md](../ARCHITECTURE.md) (960×540 logical, Phaser, placeholder atlas), [COMPONENTS.md](../COMPONENTS.md) (C-02 presentation).  
5: > **Scope:** Side-view 2D only. No isometric. No 3D.
6: 
7: ---
8: 
9: ## 1. Elevator pitch (visual)
10: 
11: Four cartoon haulers (Gnome, Sprite, Halfling, Dwarf) race a loot-stuffed sidescroller dungeon. Read like a playful NES-era heist: **control clarity first**, gold lust second, slapstick third. Think stick-figure energy with enough silhouette and color coding that four players never lose their character at a glance.
12: 
13: ---
14: 
15: ## 2. Visual pillars
16: 
17: | # | Pillar | Implication for art |
18: |---|---|---|
19: | **V1** | **NES control clarity** | Huge readable hitboxes of intent: haulers, treasure tops, spikes, switches. Prefer chunky outlines over fine hatching. UI glyphs match NES pad mental model (D-pad, A, B). |
20: | **V2** | **Playful dungeon heist** | Cartoonish, not grimdark. Traps threaten comedy (spill treasure Sonic-style), not gore. Gold gleams; characters bounce. |
21: | **V3** | **Stick → hauler silhouette** | Title mockup: simple haulers carrying letter blocks. Full game characters keep that readable body language (big head/body contrast, clear carry stack above head). |
22: | **V4** | **Biome as mood, not noise** | Each biome has a short palette and 3–5 signature decor props. Gameplay midground stays legible; parallax carries flavor. |
23: | **V5** | **Four-player color coding** | Each hauler owns a primary hue used on body, HUD, share panels, high-score portraits. Never rely on hue alone for critical traps (also use shape). |
24: | **V6** | **Letterboxed fixed canvas** | All composition designed for **960×540** logical pixels, integer scale (1×/2×/3×). No UI elements that break outside safe margins. |
25: 
26: ---
27: 
28: ## 3. Style constraints
29: 
30: ### 3.1 Line, form, shading
31: 
32: | Rule | Spec |
33: |---|---|
34: | Projection | Strict **side-view orthographic** 2D. No 3/4 view, no isometric floor tiles. |
35: | Outline | 1–2 px dark outline on characters/treasure/traps at 1× logical. Optional thicker outline for UI icons. |
36: | Shading | Flat fill + 1–2 shade steps max (cel). Specular only on gold/gems/ice. No soft airbrush gradients on sprites. |
37: | Proportions | Haulers ~**48×48** gameplay frame (see inventory); slightly exaggerated heads; arms free to hold/throw. |
38: | Animation | Snappy 8–12 fps for run; hold-friendly idle; “compelled” states (Hurt/Stunned/Falling) override clearly. |
39: | Textures | Tileable blocks 32×32; seams intentional only for crumbling/receding feedback. |
40: | Anti-alias | Prefer **nearest-neighbor** friendly art (pixel-aligned). Soft AA allowed on UI panels/logo only. |
41: 
42: ### 3.2 Forbidden / avoid
43: 
44: - Photoreal materials, PBR, film grain
45: - Blood, gore, sexualized design
46: - Tiny unreadable jewelry as primary treasure silhouettes
47: - Pure black full-screen UI (use deep navy/charcoal with gold accents)
48: - Biome-tinted character body colors that break seat identity
49: 
50: ### 3.3 References (mood, not copy)
51: 
52: - Title: stick haulers + block letters (design §1.2 / §5.4 mockups)
53: - Controls diagram: NES pad clarity (§2.1)
54: - End: four colored vertical panels + treasure pile starburst (§1.5)
55: - High scores: portrait tiles + “New!” ribbon (§1.7)
56: - Parallax stack: Far / Near / Mid / Fore / Interface (§3.3)
57: 
58: ---
59: 
60: ## 4. Character identity
61: 
62: | Character | Primary hue | Secondary | Silhouette notes | Seat color token |
63: |---|---|---|---|---|
64: | **Gnome** | Amber / orange `#F0A040` | Brown hat/boots | Short, pointed hat, stocky | Orange panel |
65: | **Sprite** | Sky blue `#50A0E8` | White/silver wing accents | Slightly taller/lighter; optional wing nubs (still 2D side) | Blue panel |
66: | **Halfling** | Magenta / pink `#E070B0` | Warm tan skin | Rounder, curly hair cue | Pink panel |
67: | **Dwarf** | Crimson / red `#E05040` | Dark beard, metal buckle | Broadest torso, shortest legs | Red panel |
68: 
69: **Consistency rules**
70: 
71: 1. Same rig / frame grid / pivot for all four haulers (swap palette + costume parts).
72: 2. Carry stack mounts at a shared **carry anchor** above head; coin sacks do **not** raise stack height (design §2.2).
73: 3. Facing: art drawn facing right; flip for left.
74: 4. AI-controlled seats may show a small “AI” badge (optional P1) but body art is identical.
75: 
76: ---
77: 
78: ## 5. Palette system
79: 
80: ### 5.1 Global / UI
81: 
82: | Role | Hex (approx) | Use |
83: |---|---|---|
84: | Canvas letterbox | `#0B0B12` | Outside 960×540 |
85: | UI ink | `#1A1A22` | Text body |
86: | UI paper | `#F4EFE4` | Panels, instructions bg |
87: | Gold accent | `#E8C040` | Logo, unique rewards, +gp |
88: | Unique reward (Gold) | `#D4A017` | Share title panels |
89: | Common reward (White) | `#F5F5F5` | Share titles |
90: | Common penalty (Blue) | `#3A6BC4` | Share titles |
91: | Unique penalty (Red) | `#C03030` | Share titles |
92: | “New!” ribbon | `#FFE28A` | High score highlight |
93: | Safe highlight | `#40E0A0` | Ready, positive pulse |
94: | Danger | `#FF5040` | Spikes, gas warn (with shape) |
95: 
96: ### 5.2 Biome palettes
97: 
98: Each biome: **BG far**, **BG mid**, **block body**, **block edge**, **accent prop**, **hazard**.
99: 
100: | Biome | Far BG | Near/Mid mood | Blocks | Accent | Hazard |
101: |---|---|---|---|---|---|
102: | **Gold (Hoard)** | Deep vault purple `#2A1840` | Warm gold haze `#5A4020` | Aged stone + gold trim | Coin piles, candelabra | Low; sparkle only |
103: | **Outside** | Sky blue `#78B4E8` | Grass green `#4A9A40` | Dirt / stone path | Trees, clouds, fence | Pits (visual cliff) |
104: | **Dungeon** | Charcoal `#1E2430` | Cool grey stone | Brick grey `#6A6E78` | Torches, banners, grates | Spikes, iron gates |
105: | **Lava** | Ember black `#1A0A08` | Magma orange `#C04010` | Basalt / scorched brick | Lava glow, cracks | Lava pits, heat shimmer (VFX) |
106: | **Ice** | Pale cyan `#C8E8F8` | Frozen blue `#70B0D0` | Ice tile cyan/white | Icicles, frost | Slippery sheen on ice blocks |
107: | **Cavern** | Brown-black `#1C1410` | Earth brown `#6A4A30` | Rough rock | Stalactites, mushrooms | Rockfall shadows |
108: | **Mist** | Desat purple `#3A3050` | Fog lavender `#8A78A8` | Soft stone, vines | Wisps, hanging moss | Reduced contrast (keep colliders clear) |
109: 
110: **Rule:** Midground blocks must retain ≥ **4:1** contrast vs character primary hues for that biome’s typical BG.
111: 
112: ### 5.3 Treasure rarity readout
113: 
114: | Rarity | Visual cue |
115: |---|---|
116: | Common | Matte metals, small sparkle 0–1 |
117: | Rare | Stronger metal/gem cut, continuous soft glint |
118: | Unique | Distinct silhouette + gold outline pulse on idle |
119: | Set piece | Shared set badge color rim; complete-set VFX on end count |
120: | Chest | Closed box form; open reveals flash then swaps to treasure sprite |
121: 
122: ---
123: 
124: ## 6. Typography & logo
125: 
126: | Use | Recommendation | Notes |
127: |---|---|---|
128: | Logo wordmark “DUNGEON” | Bold display (e.g. **Marcellus SC** or similar SC) | Design §5.2 Megan list |
129: | Logo “HAUL” letters | Physical **block letters** carried on title (H/A/U/L props) | Matches mockup §1.2 |
130: | UI body | Clean pixel or rounded sans readable at 16–20 px | Prefer open counters |
131: | Numbers (+gp, %) | Tabular / monospaced digits | End count + high scores |
132: | Share titles | Same body, color-coded by panel type | No share **values** on titles (design) |
133: 
134: **Logo lockup:** “DUNGEON” above; four haulers with H-A-U-L blocks; tagline “Press Any Button” / online “Create or Join”.
135: 
136: ---
137: 
138: ## 7. Screen composition notes
139: 
140: | Screen | Camera | Visual priorities |
141: |---|---|---|
142: | **Title** | Fixed; scrolling far BG | Logo, walk-in haulers, idle sway, run-off on start |
143: | **Credits** | Fixed | Team cards / animated team graphic; TOJam 8 credit |
144: | **High Scores** | Fixed; list scrolls | Portrait tiles, GP, %, “New!” strip, last-run footer |
145: | **Lobby** *(online)* | Fixed | Room code, 4 seat slots, character claim portraits, ready |
146: | **Instructions** | **Fixed**, no zoom | Large control diagram; minimal ground; drop-in top-left |
147: | **Hoard / Level** | Multi-target follow | Parallax stack; carry stacks; traps readable |
148: | **Fork** | Fixed | Two biome-themed exits; path select + argue mash feedback |
149: | **End** | Cinematic pans | Exit order → treasure toss → share panels → rummage → take |
150: 
151: Safe margins: **16 px** from logical edges for critical UI; interface layer always on top.
152: 
153: ---
154: 
155: ## 8. Parallax stack (presentation contract)
156: 
157: Matches C-02 / design §3.3:
158: 
159: | Layer | Scroll vs mid | Content |
160: |---|---|---|
161: | Far (~50%) | 0.5× | Sky/cave mass, large silhouettes, tileable strip |
162: | Near (~100%) | 1.0× | Tall props filling height (columns, trees, ice pillars) |
163: | Mid | 1.0× | Blocks, traps, haulers, treasure, enemies |
164: | Fore (~125%) | 1.25× | Overhangs, vines, mist wisps in front of play |
165: | Interface | Screen-space | +gp floats, share panels, HUD, argue bubbles |
166: 
167: ---
168: 
169: ## 9. Animation principles
170: 
171: 1. **Involuntary overrides** (Hurt, Stunned, Falling) snap from any state (design §2.1).
172: 2. **One-shot actions** (Throw, Drop, Push/Trip, Jump) return to Idle/Run.
173: 3. **Weight feedback:** optional squash on land when heavy stack; no need unique art if VFX + anim speed suffice for MVP.
174: 4. **Spill:** treasure becomes free world sprites with bounce; hauler plays Hurt/Stunned + short pickup lockout (no special “naked” sprite required).
175: 5. **Argue (Fork):** hauler talk-bubble or arm-wave frames; at least 3 exclamation variants in audio—visual can reuse 2–3 mouth/pose frames.
176: 
177: ---
178: 
179: ## 10. Atlas & production constraints
180: 
181: | Constraint | Spec |
182: |---|---|
183: | Logical canvas | **960×540** |
184: | World block | **32×32** (architecture assumption) |
185: | Hauler frame | **48×48** preferred (fit in 2 blocks tall visually) |
186: | Treasure | **32×32** common; **32×40** tall uniques/sets OK |
187: | Trap tile | **32×32** base; multi-tile for golem/hand |
188: | Prefer atlas sizes | Power-of-two: 512, 1024, 2048 |
189: | Pipeline | Placeholder colored rects → swap-friendly **atlas keys** (C-02) |
190: | Naming | `cat_name_variant_frame` e.g. `char_gnome_run_02` |
191: 
192: Placeholder policy: solid color + letter label is shippable for engineering; **P0 art** replaces before playtest milestone “full loop readable”.
193: 
194: ---
195: 
196: ## 11. Consistency checklist (sign-off)
197: 
198: - [ ] Four haulers share frame grid, pivots, carry anchor
199: - [ ] Character hues match end panels, lobby seats, high-score portraits
200: - [ ] Spikes/gas/lightning never color-only (shape + motion)
201: - [ ] Coin sacks visually “soft” stack (no height add)
202: - [ ] Every biome has distinct far BG + 3 near props + block set
203: - [ ] UI share colors: gold / white / blue / red only for those roles
204: - [ ] All screens compose at 960×540 with 16 px safe margin
205: - [ ] No isometric or top-down tiles in production art
206:

# Dungeon Haul — Comprehensive Graphics Asset Report & Technical Specifications

> **Document Status:** Official Production Reference for Image Asset Generation  
> **Target Canvas:** 960×540 Logical Viewport (Fixed aspect ratio, integer-scaled `FIT` letterbox)  
> **World Grid:** 32×32 Pixels per Tile Block  
> **Primary Texture Atlases:** 512×512, 1024×1024, and 2048×2048 PNGs  
> **Source Documents:** TOJam 8 Design Document (§1.0–§5.4), `docs/art/AESTHETIC-BRIEF.md`, `docs/art/ASSET-INVENTORY.md`, `docs/art/ASSET-MATRIX.md`, `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`

---

## 1. Aesthetic Pillars & Visual Style Guide

To ensure visual consistency across all generated assets, all art created for **Dungeon Haul** must strictly adhere to the following unified style rules:

### 1.1 Core Visual Pillars
1. **NES Control Clarity:** Crisp, instantly readable silhouettes and hitboxes. Every entity (hauler, trap, treasure, switch) must communicate its state immediately to players on a 960×540 viewport. Avoid overly noisy hatching or photorealistic clutter.
2. **Playful Dungeon Heist Aesthetics:** Bright, energetic cartoon tone (slapstick heist rather than grimdark dungeon crawler). Stuns drop loot Sonic-style; gold and gems gleam with exaggerated sparkles; characters feature expressive body language.
3. **Strict Orthographic 2D Side-View:** 100% side-view orthographic perspective. No top-down, no 3/4 isometric floor angles, no 3D elements.
4. **4-Player Character Color Coding:** Distinct primary hues anchor each seat across all screens (sprites, UI panels, HUDs, high score portraits):
   - **Gnome:** Amber / Orange (`#F0A040`) — Short, pointy hat, stocky build.
   - **Sprite:** Sky Blue (`#50A0E8`) — Slightly taller/lighter, wing nubs, sleek build.
   - **Halfling:** Magenta / Pink (`#E070B0`) — Rounder physique, curly hair cue.
   - **Dwarf:** Crimson / Red (`#E05040`) — Broadest torso, shortest legs, dark braided beard.
5. **Clean Outlines & Flat/Cel Shading:** 
   - 1–2 px dark outline at 1× logical scale on characters, treasures, and traps.
   - Flat color fills with 1–2 shade steps maximum (clean cel shading).
   - Nearest-neighbor friendly pixel alignment.

---

## 2. Global Asset Specifications & Dimensions Summary

| Entity Class | Standard Frame Size | Anchor / Alignment | Animation Rate | Primary Palette Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Hauler Characters** | 48×48 px | Bottom-center origin (feet at y=48, carry anchor at top of head) | 8–12 fps (Run: 6f, Idle: 4f, Jump: 3f, etc.) | Seat-specific primary hue + accent clothing |
| **Common / Rare Treasures** | 32×32 px (32×40 tall) | Bottom-center origin | 1–4 frame glint loops on rare/unique | Vivid gold, silver, bronze, gems |
| **Coin Sacks (Flat Stack)** | 32×28 px, 36×32 px | Bottom-center | Static | Matte burlap with gold coin rim |
| **Chests** | 40×32 px | Bottom-center | 2-frame open animation | Wood, Silver, Gold, Magic glow |
| **World Tile Blocks** | 32×32 px | Top-left grid aligned | Autotile 16/47-tile bitmasks | Biome-specific ground colors |
| **Switches** | Up: 32×24 px / Down: 32×16 px | Ground flush | State toggle | Red/Steel plate with pressure spring |
| **Heavy Switches** | Up: 40×28 px / Down: 40×20 px | Ground flush | State toggle | Heavy iron plate with weight pips |
| **Gates** | 32×64 px (2 tiles tall) | Top-left grid | 4-frame retract / open | Iron / Gold / Biome stone |
| **Traps (Spikes/Crumble/Recede)** | 32×32 px | Grid aligned | 3–4 frame strain/slide/zap | High-contrast danger accents |
| **Enemies (Golem / Phantom)** | Golem: 64×64 px / Hand: 48×64 px | Bottom-center | 4–6 frame walk/attack/flee loops | Stone grey / Spectral violet |
| **UI Screen Elements & Panels** | Varied (e.g. Panels 200×400 px) | Fixed logical coordinates | Static / gentle pulse | Paper beige (`#F4EFE4`), Gold (`#E8C040`), Navy |

---

## 3. Exhaustive Image Asset Catalog & Technical Specs

Below is the complete list of all **348 logical image assets** required for Dungeon Haul, organized into 8 production categories with exact dimensions, animation details, priorities, and visual descriptions.

---

### Category 1: Characters & Player Sprites (52 Assets)

All four haulers share a standard 48×48 px frame bounding box, identical pivot points, and a shared carry anchor coordinate above the head.

#### 1.1 Gnome Sprites (`char:gnome` — `#F0A040` Amber/Orange)
- **`char_gnome_idle`** (48×48 px, 4 frames, loop 6-8 fps, P0): Gnome standing in amber tunic and pointed hat, subtle breathing/idle bounce.
- **`char_gnome_run`** (48×48 px, 6 frames, loop 12 fps, P0): Energetic side-scrolling run cycle, arms swinging, hat trailing back.
- **`char_gnome_jump`** (48×48 px, 3 frames, one-shot, P0): Rise pose (tucked knees), apex pose, and falling land pose.
- **`char_gnome_duck`** (48×48 px, 2 frames, holdable, P0): Crouching low, hands near ground for picking up loot.
- **`char_gnome_drop`** (48×48 px, 3 frames, one-shot, P0): Quick motion releasing top item from carried stack.
- **`char_gnome_throw`** (48×48 px, 4 frames, one-shot, P0): Upward and forward two-handed overhead toss pose.
- **`char_gnome_pushtrip`** (48×48 px, 4 frames, one-shot, P0): Shove forward / trip leg swipe when empty-handed.
- **`char_gnome_hurt`** (48×48 px, 3 frames, compelled state, P0): Recoiling backward from trap/hit, wide shocked eyes.
- **`char_gnome_stunned`** (48×48 px, 4 frames, loop 8 fps, P0): Wobbling dazed stance, head spinning (paired with stun stars VFX).
- **`char_gnome_falling`** (48×48 px, 3 frames, compelled state, P0): Pit flail pose, arms and legs spinning in mid-air.
- **`char_gnome_portrait`** (64×64 px, static portrait, P0): High-score, lobby seat, and results screen character portrait icon.
- **`char_title_stick_gnome`** (64×96 px, 4 frames walk, P0): Simplified stick-figure silhouette carrying an 'H' letter block for the title screen.

#### 1.2 Sprite Sprites (`char:sprite` — `#50A0E8` Sky Blue)
- **`char_sprite_idle`** (48×48 px, 4 frames, loop 6-8 fps, P0): Sky blue outfit with tiny wing nubs, gentle floating hover/idle.
- **`char_sprite_run`** (48×48 px, 6 frames, loop 12 fps, P0): Swift forward dash with trailing wing accents.
